opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowships for early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research. The Trust contributes 100% of salary (up to £56,000) in year one and 50% (up to £28,000) in years two and three, with up to £6,000 per annum research expenses. Approximately 145 fellowships available in 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or other institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) eligible UK independent research institutes/organisations. Applicants must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Grants for innovative and original research projects at UK universities, tenable up to five years, with a maximum value of £500,000. Assessed via a two-stage outline and detailed application process. The outline stage is currently paused; detailed applications must be submitted by 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical, policy-driven, and commercially-oriented research

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas; some specialist arts institutions permitted.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills of academic staff and students in an underrepresented research area. Visits last 3 to 12 months, with priority to new or recent collaborations.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK, with an established research track record. Priority to those whose teaching/administrative duties have impacted their research.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, tenable between 3 and 24 months, with a maximum value of £70,000 for replacement costs and research expenses. Application materials available on the page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post at a UK university or eligible independent research organisation; must live in the UK for at least 26 weeks per year and have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for retired or partially retired senior researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication, tenable between 3 and 24 months. Application materials available in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at lecturer level or equivalent in a UK university with research degree awarding powers; at least two years' post-PhD experience; must not have led a research team or held project grant funding over £100k.
opportunities.summary: Centenary Research Leadership Awards support talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, with grants of up to £1 million over 4 to 5 years. Opens January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical, policy-driven, advocacy and commercially-oriented research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million (up to £1m per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered with the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers; centres may be single-university or collaborations, with international participation encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Leverhulme Centenary Research Centres support outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship, with up to £10 million over up to 10 years. Expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.
discipline_tags: All disciplines within Trust remit, excluding medical/clinical research
